pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_debug/console/ConsoleSection.tsx:44 This context is a React dashboard that forwards UE console command strings to an external engine over the /api/ue5-bridge HTTP bridge. It implements no language engine and has no guest-visible global, so the subject's precondition does not hold. A search of sub_debug found 0 hits for $debug, createRealm, hiddenClass, setStackLimit, newGlobal, bytecode and disassemble. A search of all of src/ found no isolated-vm, quickjs, vm.createContext, new Function( or ShadowRealm.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_debug/console/ConsoleSection.tsx:43 The console works on the host side over HTTP to an external UE process. No guest global is injected anywhere.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_debug/_shared/data.ts:71 The catalog lists UE stat and show console commands, which report rates and overlays. They are not pure queries about an object's shape, its elements or a string's representation in a guest language.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_debug/_shared/data.ts:78 The only settable knobs are gameplay console cheats and world commands. There is no recursion, stack or optimizer limit that a guest language can set.
